gates.mechanism_control: the SAME class instantiated with n_mem=1 reproduces the v1 near-constant-scalar defect and MUST fail this gate
gates.fail_if: value not met OR the n_mem=1 arm passes

gates.negative_control: shuffled (wave, trace) pairing must drop to the floor

gates.fail_if: greedy output not identical OR the negative control is identical

gates.bound: 1.0 accuracy; a corrupt wave must be rejected

gates.fail_if: no improvement OR the frozen control improves as much

gates.negative_control: random orthonormal basis must score far lower
an unrelated random basis must exceed the bound
identical psi_t and psi_next must give 0
deliberately correlated engrams must exceed 0.12 before retraction
